units.purpose: Provide a professional NSIS install/upgrade/uninstall path for Workspace on Windows.
units.userValue: A user can install, upgrade, repair, and remove Workspace without engineering assistance.
units.engineeringValue: Reproducible installer package, hooks, and install-manifest version detection.
units.constitutionalJustification: Production layer; Presentation/install surface only — no new Information Owner.
units.productionReadinessDelta: Engineering Complete for install foundation; not Release Ready (unsigned).
operationalAcceptance: A user can run the installer without developer instructions
A user can uninstall cleanly or knowingly keep data
A user can reinstall/upgrade over an existing install

units.purpose: Ensure one Workspace process owns local state at a time.
units.userValue: Opening Workspace twice no longer risks corrupted Moments/DB behaviour.
units.engineeringValue: Process-level Singular Truth before kernel init.
units.constitutionalJustification: Singular Truth / Conservation at process boundary; Runtime only.
entryCriteria: Installer foundation usable or tauri dev
units.productionReadinessDelta: Engineering Complete + Production Ready for process integrity.
regressionRisks: Plugin order wrong allows dual kernel
Focus fails on odd window state
units.rollbackStrategy: Remove plugin registration; accept dual-instance risk temporarily.
operationalAcceptance: A user can relaunch Workspace and return to the existing session
A user can avoid two competing Workspace windows editing the same data

units.purpose: Let operators produce privacy-preserving local diagnostics without a developer present.
units.userValue: A user can export logs/version info for support when something fails.
units.engineeringValue: File logs, rotation, export_support_bundle IPC, Conversation path.
units.constitutionalJustification: Observability + Evidence; privacy — no Moments DB contents; no telemetry.
entryCriteria: Dependency Authority lists B1 Ready Now
units.productionReadinessDelta: Engineering Complete for support export; Production Ready pending Owner Operational Acceptance.
units.rollbackStrategy: Disable file logger attach; remove Conversation intent.
operationalAcceptance: A user can ask Conversation to export a support package
A user can understand the package excludes Moments
A user can find the saved folder path from the reply

units.purpose: Publish integrity hashes for installer artifacts so downloads can be verified.
units.userValue: A user (or CI) can confirm the setup.exe was not tampered with in transit.
units.engineeringValue: SHA-256 sidecars + verify:artifact-checksums feeding release automation.
units.constitutionalJustification: Integrity / Observability of distributed Effects artifacts — Production/Repository Standards.
units.productionReadinessDelta: Engineering Complete for install integrity hashes; not Release Ready (unsigned).
units.rollbackStrategy: Stop publishing sidecars; remove verify from CI.
operationalAcceptance: A user can verify a downloaded installer hash against a published checksum
A release engineer can regenerate checksums in one command

units.purpose: Reduce unused IPC attack surface to the commands Workspace actually needs.
units.userValue: Less risk of obscure commands being abused; clearer product surface.
units.engineeringValue: Hard quarantine or removal of unused registered commands; smaller surface-size risk.
units.constitutionalJustification: Least privilege / Singular Truth of entry — Repository Standards + Runtime.
units.rollbackStrategy: Restore command registration from git; loosen quarantine list.
operationalAcceptance: A user can complete supported Conversation workflows after quarantine
A developer can still run required diagnostics without inventing new IPC

units.purpose: Provide persistent desktop presence that serves Conversation without becoming a second product.
units.userValue: Workspace remains reachable from the tray; Exit/Show are obvious.
units.engineeringValue: Tray icon, restore, Exit policy foundation for C2.
units.constitutionalJustification: Product Gravity — tray supports Conversation; Presentation/Production only.
units.productionReadinessDelta: Major perceived Production Ready lift for desktop presence.
units.rollbackStrategy: Disable tray plugin; keep window-only lifecycle.
operationalAcceptance: A user can restore Conversation from the tray
A user can Exit Workspace from the tray without confusion
A user can use the tray without seeing a second app compete with Conversation

units.purpose: Tell the truth when session/DB recovery yields empty or corrupt state.
units.userValue: A user understands recovery happened instead of silent empty desktop.
units.engineeringValue: Presentation of existing kernel checksum recovery Facts.
units.constitutionalJustification: Observability / truthful Experience — Presentation over Evidence.
verification: unit tests for recovery path if added
units.rollbackStrategy: Revert copy to prior quiet recovery.
operationalAcceptance: A user can understand that recovery occurred
A user can see that success was not claimed when state was reset

units.purpose: Automate validation and artifact checks on the active development branch.
units.userValue: Indirect — fewer broken builds reach humans.
verification: GitHub Actions green on sample PR
units.productionReadinessDelta: Release engineering maturity; not Release Ready alone.
units.rollbackStrategy: Narrow workflow triggers; make jobs advisory temporarily.
operationalAcceptance: A release engineer can see pass/fail without local full matrix
A release engineer can see the pipeline fail when installer verify is broken

units.purpose: Authenticode-sign Windows installers so users and OS trust the binary.
units.userValue: SmartScreen/trust barriers drop for legitimate installs.
units.engineeringValue: Signed artifacts unlock updater integrity and Release Ready.
units.constitutionalJustification: Trust of Effects delivered to the OS — Production.
units.rollbackStrategy: Ship unsigned with explicit Owner risk acceptance only.
operationalAcceptance: A user can install without unexplained SmartScreen distrust (normal channels)
A release engineer can sign in CI or one documented command

units.purpose: Deliver trusted in-app updates without full reinstall.
units.userValue: A user can stay current safely.
units.engineeringValue: Tauri updater + signed manifests + failure recovery.
units.constitutionalJustification: Production; Authority still gates Effects; no telemetry dependence.
units.rollbackStrategy: Disable updater endpoint; instruct manual A0 reinstall.
operationalAcceptance: A user can update without losing Moments
A user can understand when an update fails
A user can update without a developer workflow

units.purpose: Automate signed artifact publication and verification.
units.engineeringValue: Release workflow producing signed setup + notes.
units.rollbackStrategy: Disable publish job; yank bad release.
operationalAcceptance: A release engineer can ship a signed build without tribal knowledge
A user can obtain the intended channel artifact

units.purpose: Define close vs Exit vs tray-hide so shutdown matches user intent.
units.userValue: Closing the window does not mysteriously kill or zombie Workspace.
units.constitutionalJustification: Presentation purity for chrome; Production lifecycle.
regressionRisks: Users lose work on unexpected Exit
operationalAcceptance: A user can predict what Close does
A user can fully quit Workspace when they intend to

units.purpose: Audit remaining IPC/capabilities for least privilege after quarantine.
units.userValue: Fewer surprising permission prompts and tighter OS privilege use.
units.rollbackStrategy: Restore prior capability grants with documented exception.
operationalAcceptance: A user can complete supported workflows after permission tightening
A user can see truthful guidance when OS permission is denied

units.purpose: Capture local crash evidence for inclusion in support bundles.
units.userValue: Hard crashes become diagnosable without reinventing the failure.
units.engineeringValue: Local minidump/WER opt-in; attach to B1 bundle.
blockingConditions: Priority below Ready Now critical path
exitCriteria: included in support export when present
operationalAcceptance: A user can export a support package that notes a crash occurred
A user can keep crash dumps local with no network upload by default

units.purpose: Improve animations, a11y, and micro-interactions without redesigning UI.
units.userValue: Workspace feels calmer and more accessible.
entryCriteria: Owner prioritizes polish over Ready Now units
operationalAcceptance: A user can operate primary flows by keyboard
A user can use reduced motion without distracting animation

units.purpose: Recover from a failed upgrade to a known-good install.
units.userValue: A bad update does not strand the user.
units.engineeringValue: Rollback path tied to updater/OS previous version.
units.rollbackStrategy: Manual A0 reinstall from last good setup.exe.
successMetrics: Failed upgrade returns to prior version
operationalAcceptance: A user can return to a working Workspace after a failed update
A user can learn what to do if automatic rollback fails
